info.title: v2.shop.get_warehouse_detail
info.description: For given shop id and region, return warehouse info including warehouse id, address id and location id, return all warehouse with once call.

get.description: For given shop id and region, return warehouse info including warehouse id, address id and location id, return all warehouse with once call.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

parameters.name: warehouse_type
parameters.description: Type of warehouse. Applicable values: - 1: Pickup Warehouse - 2: Return Warehouse Default value is 1 (Pickup Warehouse)

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.

values:
<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/shop/get_warehouse_detail?access_token=access_token&partner_id=partner_id&region=ID&shop_id=shop_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'GET',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;

x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Messages about the error and it's cause if there're errors. It will be just return the updated information if there's no error.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: request_id
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The identifier for an API request for error tracking.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: warehouse_id
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Warehouse address identifier. It should be unique for every warehouse address

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: warehouse_name
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The warehouse name filled in when creating the warehouse address

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: warehouse_type
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Type of warehouse. Applicable values: - 1: Pickup Warehouse - 2: Return Warehouse

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: location_id
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Location identifier for stocks. Different location_ids represent that your addresses are in different item stocks

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: address
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Detail address of your warehouse address

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: town
x-shopee-response-parameters.Sample: Av Maria H A dos Santos

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: state_code
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: State code of your warehouse address

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: holiday_mode_state
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The holiday mode state of your address. 0: not in holiday mode 1: holiday mode active 2: holiday mode is turning of 3: holiday mode is turning on
